_what: How a recording's kept transcript becomes cut proposals as typed lines (auto-edit.mjs). `algorithm_version` is written with every kept answer, so changing the rules below means raising it and no earlier answer is shown as current. `fillers` is the word list the filler mode strips (a DATA edit adds one). `proposal_kind` is the edit decision each span becomes. `words` is what the status and thinking lines say; {count} is how many timed words were read, {spans} how many cuts were found, {seconds} how long they are together. The modes themselves (silent_pauses, filler_words and any added) are rows in suggestion-stream.json.
